notes:
Family History Centre: The birth record for Anna Dorothea Pfeiffer is found on LDS film # 758374, Record #4.  Henry Brodersen has provided a "rough, over-the-phone" interpretation of this document which is as follows:(The hard-copy print of this digital record is in the Zelmer book under the LDS tab)
It is a recording of the birth of Anna Dorothea Pfeiffer by the Pastor of the Evangelical Church in Stawiszyn, congregtion of Distric Kaliscz.  Anna Dorothea Pfeiffer, baptised the 22 of September, 1815 at 8 o'clock in the morning.   Johann Christian Pfeiffer who is 28 years old of # 3 Pryzanie ? and has sired a child of female gender which on the 15th of the previous month was born at noon to his wife Beata Louise Busch(en) from Posen child named Anna Dorothea.  After a previous statement in the presence of Martin Schulz of 25 years of age and Wilhelm ____________ Vorland ? of #19 lived in, Gottlieb Minke who is 21 years old who is a bachelor & living at home.
From this it is evident that Johann Christian Pfeiffer is the father (previously known as Christian Pfeiffer) and the mother is Beata Louise Busch, also previously known.  Since the date of this record is 1815, and Johann Christian Pfeiffer is said to be 28 years old, this places his birthdate at 1787.
